Early winter, upbeat and bright
The planners are ready
Pet travel made simple

Aurelia Skyways is keeping the Companion Animal Travel Desk busy in the best way, with clear preflight guidance and calm check-ins for every traveler and pet. Staff are focused on smooth handoffs, quick answers, and steady support for families heading out with companions. <<FACT F007>> The safety coordinator is also watching for hazards and helping everyone avoid last-minute stress.

Over at the lounge side, the team is keeping things friendly and orderly for guests passing through Port Isolde. <<FACT F003>> <<FACT F021>> Travelers get a warm welcome, and pets get a quiet space that feels easy to use and easy to trust. Companion Animal Travel Desk
